name: Office/outpatient visit, established patient, 20-29 min
plain_english: Routine follow-up visit with a doctor for an existing, stable medical condition.
notes: Frequently overbilled as 99214 or 99215 if the visit was brief.

name: Office/outpatient visit, established patient, 30-39 min
plain_english: Intermediate visit addressing multiple conditions, medication adjustments, or worsening symptoms.
notes: Most common evaluation & management code in the US.

name: Office/outpatient visit, established patient, 40-54 min
plain_english: Comprehensive high-complexity visit with high medical decision-making risk.
notes: Check medical notes to confirm at least 40 minutes or high medical risk was documented.

name: Emergency department visit, moderate severity
plain_english: ER physician evaluation for moderate symptoms requiring urgent attention (e.g., minor trauma, simple infection).
notes: Professional fee for the ER doctor only; hospital facility fees appear separately under Revenue Code 0450.

name: Emergency department visit, high severity without immediate threat
plain_english: ER evaluation for high-severity illness requiring tests, imaging, or IV medications (e.g., severe abdominal pain, chest pain workup).
notes: Very common ER code, frequently inflated by hospital coding algorithms.

name: Emergency department visit, high severity with immediate threat
plain_english: ER physician evaluation for life-threatening or organ-threatening emergencies.
notes: Often billed even when the patient walked in and was discharged safely within a couple of hours.

name: MRI lower extremity other than joint without contrast (Knee/Leg)
plain_english: Knee or lower leg MRI without IV contrast dye.
notes: Huge variation between independent imaging centers ($300-$500) vs hospital outpatient facilities ($2,000+).

name: MRI lumbar spine without contrast
plain_english: Lower back MRI scan without contrast dye.
notes: Often billed with unbundled reading/professional component (modifier 26) and technical component (modifier TC).

name: CT scan thorax/chest without contrast
plain_english: Computed tomography (CT) scan of the chest without IV dye.
notes: Commonly ordered in ER for shortness of breath or trauma.

name: Comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP)
plain_english: Routine blood test checking 14 biomarkers: kidney, liver, electrolyte, and blood sugar balance.
notes: Hospital labs often bill 10x-25x the commercial Quest/Labcorp rate.

name: Complete blood count (CBC) with automated differential
plain_english: Standard blood test measuring red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets.

name: Lipid panel
plain_english: Blood cholesterol test checking HDL, LDL, total cholesterol, and triglycerides.
notes: Often covered at 100% under ACA preventive care mandate with diagnosis Z00.00.

name: Colonoscopy, diagnostic, flexible
plain_english: Examination of the large bowel with a flexible camera.
notes: If performed as screening (HCPCS G0121/G0105), it should be 100% covered without deductible/coinsurance.

name: Arthroscopy, knee, surgical; with meniscectomy
plain_english: Minimally invasive knee scope surgery to trim or remove a torn meniscus.
notes: Surgeon fee only; ambulatory surgical center (ASC) fee or hospital facility fee is separate.

name: Ambulance service, advanced life support, emergency, level 1 (ALS1)
plain_english: Emergency ambulance dispatch equipped with paramedic level life-support care.
notes: Ambulance ground services are protected under state surprise billing laws in several states.
